name: Alice
summary: A girl who falls down a rabbit-hole into Wonderland and later walks through a looking-glass.

name: Alice's sister
summary: Alice's elder sister, reading on the bank when Alice falls asleep.

name: Dinah
summary: Alice's cat.

name: Kitty
summary: Dinah's black kitten, whom Alice scolds before going through the glass.

name: White Rabbit
summary: A Rabbit with pink eyes and a waistcoat-pocket watch; herald at the trial.

name: Mouse
summary: A Mouse in the pool of tears who tells a long and a sad tale.

name: Dodo
summary: The bird who proposes the Caucus-race.

name: Bill
summary: A Lizard sent down the White Rabbit's chimney; later a juror.

name: Caterpillar
summary: A blue Caterpillar smoking a hookah on a mushroom.

name: Duchess
summary: A Duchess nursing a baby that turns into a pig.

name: Cheshire Cat
summary: The Duchess's grinning cat, who can vanish all but its grin.

name: Hatter
summary: Host of the mad tea-party; a witness at the trial.

name: March Hare
summary: The Hatter's companion at the tea-party.

name: Dormouse
summary: The sleepy guest at the tea-party.

name: Queen of Hearts
summary: The Queen of Wonderland's croquet-ground, who orders heads off.

name: King of Hearts
summary: The Queen of Hearts' husband, judge at the trial of the Knave.

name: Knave of Hearts
summary: Accused of stealing the tarts.

name: Gryphon
summary: Takes Alice to hear the Mock Turtle's story.

name: Mock Turtle
summary: Tells of his schooldays in the sea and sings of turtle soup.

name: Red Queen
summary: A chess queen in the Looking-glass world, who shows Alice the board and runs to stay in place.

name: White Queen
summary: A chess queen who lives backwards and turns into a Sheep.

name: Red King
summary: The sleeping chess king who may be dreaming Alice.

name: White King
summary: A chess king who keeps a memorandum-book and sends his horses and men to Humpty Dumpty.

name: White Knight
summary: A chess knight who keeps falling off his horse and sings Alice a song of his own invention.

name: Red Knight
summary: A chess knight who claims Alice as his prisoner.

name: Tweedledum
summary: One of the twin brothers who recite The Walrus and the Carpenter.

name: Tweedledee
summary: Tweedledum's twin brother.

name: Humpty Dumpty
summary: An egg on a wall who explains Jabberwocky.

name: Lion
summary: Fights the Unicorn for the crown.

name: Unicorn
summary: Fights the Lion for the crown.

name: Haigha
summary: The White King's Anglo-Saxon messenger, who goes about like the March Hare.

name: Hatta
summary: The White King's other messenger, just out of prison, who looks like the Hatter.

name: Sheep
summary: The knitting Sheep who keeps a shop.

name: Gnat
summary: A Gnat as big as a chicken who tells Alice about Looking-glass insects.

name: Tiger-lily
summary: A talking flower in the garden of live flowers.

name: Wonderland
summary: The world down the rabbit-hole.

name: Looking-glass House
summary: The room behind the drawing-room mirror.
